global: A rich, dark shoyu ramen broth cradles tender chashu pork and menma, arranged atop golden noodles. The white bowl rests on a warm wooden table, softly lit to highlight the broth’s depth and toppings’ textures.

regions.background: Wooden table surface with warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and glossy reflections from ambient light.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is dark brown, glossy, and rich, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has a glistening, marbled texture with pinkish-red meat and a slightly crispy, browned surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as three golden-brown, slightly curved, textured strips with visible fibrous surfaces.
